text.tspan: Fertility rate vs. GDP per capita

tspan.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.tspan: The total fertility rate summarizes the total number of
births a woman would have, if she experienced the
birth rates seen in women of each age group in one
particular year across her childbearing years. This is
shown against gross domestic product (GDP) per capita,
adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs
Births per woman (live births per woman)
Feenstra et al. – Penn World Table (2025)

tspan.tspan: GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021

text.tspan: prices, using multiple benchmark years to adjust for
differences in living costs between countries over time.
